column2: There is an item kiosk to the right of the entrance to the emporium proper, lets you move items in and out of local storage more easily than the cargo elevator, though doesn't count towards turn-ins, the way I prefer to turn in items especially in bulk is carry it in a stor*all box, store the box either via the cargo elevator or drag it into the item kiosk, then unload the box, go to the cargo elevator kiosk and send what you're turning in up the cargo elevator, and then down it to turn in. Can make stacks of the items in the item kiosk UI and then move the stacks to the cargo elevator in the cargo elevator kiosk.
